secret.title: Copy it now
secret.description: This is the only time it is shown. We store only a fingerprint of it.

apiKeys.createDescription: API keys call your pools (and pools shared with you). They never manage anything.
apiKeys.scopeAllHint: Every pool you own or may use, including ones added later.
apiKeys.poolsUnavailable: Your pools could not be loaded. Choose all pools for now.
apiKeys.loadFailed: Could not load your API keys.
apiKeys.revokeDescription: Programs using this key stop working at once. This cannot be undone.

agents.mcpHint: Agents that support OAuth connect with this URL alone; others use a token below.
agents.tokensDescription: Tokens you give an agent. Only you can create or revoke them; agents can never create tokens or share anything.
agents.levelReadHint: Reads pools, runtimes, nodes, metrics and the request log. Changes nothing.
agents.levelFullHint: Everything an agent may do: configure, start and stop runtimes, and run commands and edit files on Full-control nodes. It can never grant access.
agents.fullUnavailable: Read-only: this agent did not ask to make changes. To allow Full, reconnect it asking for mcp:write.
agents.loadFailed: Could not load your agent tokens.
agents.revokeDescription: The agent loses access at once. This cannot be undone.
agents.oauthDescription: Agents you approved in the browser. Read-only takes effect at once and ends the agent's running Full work; Full applies from its next call.
agents.disconnectDescription: The agent must ask for your approval again to reconnect.
agents.mcpOff: MCP is turned off on this server, so agent tokens cannot be created.

shares.createDescription: Share by e-mail. Only an account whose e-mail address was verified gets it at once; anyone else gets an invite link to accept.
shares.noOwnPools: Create a pool before sharing one.
shares.poolsLoadFailed: Your pools could not be loaded.
shares.noOwnRuntimes: Create a runtime before sharing one.
shares.runtimesLoadFailed: Your runtimes could not be loaded.
shares.runtimeHint: They can read every version of the definition and copy it into their own runtimes. Nothing runs on your nodes.
shares.canUseHint: Call the pool with their own API keys.
shares.canContributeHint: Add their own served models to the pool.
shares.needOne: Choose can use, can contribute, or both.
shares.inviteLinkDescription: No e-mail could be sent. Give this link to {{email}}; it is shown only once and works until {{date}}.
shares.byMeEmpty: You have not shared a pool yet.
shares.runtimesByMeEmpty: You have not shared a runtime definition yet.
shares.withMeEmpty: Nothing is shared with you yet.
shares.removeDescription: They lose access at once. Models they contributed are removed from the pool.
shares.removeRuntimeDescription: They can no longer see its versions. Copies they already made stay theirs.
shares.leaveDescription: You lose access at once, and models you contributed are removed from the pool.
shares.contributeOffDescription: Their {{count}} contributed models are removed from the pool.

contributions.empty: No pool lets you contribute yet. A pool's owner can share it with you with can contribute.
contributions.loadFailed: Could not load the pools you may contribute to.
contributions.noModels: You contribute nothing to this pool yet.
contributions.ownHardwareOnly: The owner routes to their own hardware only for now: your models stay listed but get no traffic.
contributions.addDescription: Pick a pool shared with you, then one of your served models of the same type. It serves that pool's requests alongside the owner's models until you withdraw it.
contributions.allOwnHardwareOnly: Every pool you may contribute to is routed to its owner's hardware only for now.
contributions.chooseModel: Choose one of your served models.
contributions.noMatchingModels: You serve no {{type}} model that is not in this pool yet.
contributions.addToShared: Add to a pool shared with me
contributions.withdrawDescription: The pool stops sending requests to this model. You can add it again later.

fork.sectionDescription: Read-only definitions someone shared with you. Fork one to get your own runtime from its current version.
fork.loadFailed: Could not load the runtime definitions shared with you.
fork.empty: No runtime definitions are shared with you.
fork.title: Fork {{name}}
fork.description: Your copy starts at version 1. Later changes by its owner do not reach it.
fork.nodeRequired: Pick the node it runs on.
fork.nodesFailed: Your nodes could not be loaded. Try again later.
fork.noNodes: You have no nodes yet. Add a node first.
fork.startableHint: This runtime starts on demand, on any of your nodes that fits it, so it needs no node now.

ownKey.label: Cloud fallback key
ownKey.hint: When this pool falls back to the cloud, the owner lets you pay with your own key instead, using one of your provider models that stands in for {{model}}.
ownKey.loadFailed: Your provider models could not be loaded.
ownKey.noModels: You have no provider models to use your own key with.
ownKey.unavailable: A model you no longer have
ownKey.saved: Your own key is used for this pool's cloud fallback
ownKey.cleared: The owner's key is used again
